description: This file defines the JsonRPCServerCalls class which implements JSON-RPC server methods for retrieving and querying SugarCRM/SuiteCRM data. It includes methods to retrieve a specific record and to execute complex queries, interacting with various CRM components and configuration. The file also includes external dependencies relevant to CRM functionality and JSON processing.

classes.name: JsonRPCServerCalls
classes.description: A class providing JSON-RPC methods for retrieving and querying CRM records, acting as an API endpoint for external clients.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a single CRM record as a simplified array, given a module name and record ID.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a search query across specified modules with conditions, sorting, and limits, returning a list of records.
